question: According to the Carbon Brief Review 2019 data, India is the world's ________ largest emitter of greenhouse gases (GHGs).
solution:
The correct answer is __**third**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India is the world's **third** largest emitter of greenhouse gases (GHGs) according to the Carbon Brief Review 2019 data.
 
• Greenhouse gases contribute significantly to global warming and climate change.
 
• Major sources of GHG emissions in India include energy production, industrial processes, agriculture, and waste management.
 
• India has been taking various measures to reduce its carbon footprint, including increasing the share of renewable energy in its energy mix and enhancing energy efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Carbon Brief Review provides comprehensive analysis and data on global greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• China and the United States are the top two largest emitters of greenhouse gases globally.
 
• Efforts to mitigate climate change require international cooperation and commitments from all major GHG emitting countries.
 
• India has set ambitious targets under its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) to the Paris Agreement to reduce the intensity of its greenhouse gas emissions.
